analogy.rationale: Membrane integrity inhibitors disrupt the plasma membrane, causing rapid loss of ionic gradients and cell stress; among listed classes, local anesthetics also act on membrane ion channels/lipid bilayers, while antiinfective/antiviral/antiprotozoal/antimalarial agents often target membranes or have nonspecific membrane effects, though with lower transcriptional similarity.
